There are two very tiny indentations on the shiny steel bezel which can only be seen in specific lighting. The dial is white with black roman numeral dial markers, easy to read! The blue alligator strap is also in excellent condition, showing no rips, tears, stretch or major creasing. The buckle is free and clear of any scratches as well. This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

There are two very tiny indentations on the shiny steel bezel which can only be seen in specific lighting. The dial is white with black roman numeral dial markers, easy to read! The blue alligator strap is also in excellent condition, showing no rips, tears, stretch or major creasing. The buckle is free and clear of any scratches as well. This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

The blue alligator strap is also in excellent condition, showing no rips, tears, stretch or major creasing. The buckle is free and clear of any scratches as well. This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

CAR00163.description: You’re viewing this Cartier Santos 100 2656 Stainless Steel 38mm Watch on Blue Strap. This Cartier Santos 100 is in excellent condition for being a pre-owned watch. The stainless steel case shows very minimal scratches which are hard to see due to the brushed finish. The steel bezel may show very faint scratches as well. There are two very tiny indentations on the shiny steel bezel which can only be seen in specific lighting. The dial is white with black roman numeral dial markers, easy to read! The blue alligator strap is also in excellent condition, showing no rips, tears, stretch or major creasing. The buckle is free and clear of any scratches as well. This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

The blue alligator strap is also in excellent condition, showing no rips, tears, stretch or major creasing. The buckle is free and clear of any scratches as well. This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

The stainless steel case shows very minimal scratches which are hard to see due to the brushed finish. The steel bezel may show very faint scratches as well. There are two very tiny indentations on the shiny steel bezel which can only be seen in specific lighting. The dial is white with black roman numeral dial markers, easy to read! The blue alligator strap is also in excellent condition, showing no rips, tears, stretch or major creasing. The buckle is free and clear of any scratches as well. This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

The blue alligator strap is also in excellent condition, showing no rips, tears, stretch or major creasing. The buckle is free and clear of any scratches as well. This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

There are two very tiny indentations on the shiny steel bezel which can only be seen in specific lighting. The dial is white with black roman numeral dial markers, easy to read! The blue alligator strap is also in excellent condition, showing no rips, tears, stretch or major creasing. The buckle is free and clear of any scratches as well. This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!

There are two very tiny indentations on the shiny steel bezel which can only be seen in specific lighting. The dial is white with black roman numeral dial markers, easy to read! The blue alligator strap is also in excellent condition, showing no rips, tears, stretch or major creasing. The buckle is free and clear of any scratches as well. This Cartier Santos 100 runs properly and deserves a new home!
